responses.message: I have an important delivery from Dr. Willett.
He gave me this floppy disc so you could decrypt it or something. It's got blueprints to the Skycorps mother ship on it.

suite.message: It's me. I'm Spencer.
Well, it wasn't supposed to become such a big thing. I just needed a way to convince the local authorities of my disappearance.
Plus, it served as a pretty good distraction for them.
I absolutely cannot under any circumstances be found by the Grand Island Police.
I am not cut out for prison!
It's a long story, but basically the government doesn't like when you poke around their top secret files without the right security clearance. Or any security clearance...
So I had to flee here, and I've been in hiding for years now.
But anyway, what did you need from me?
Doc! Man, it's been a while since I've heard from him. Unfortunately, I had to block all incoming communications to stay hidden, so I haven't really heard from anyone...
What does he need?
I can take a look. You have it on you?
Alright, gimme a couple minutes.
Okay, all done.
It's fake.
The floppy. It's a fake disc. Well, it's a real disc. But it's not the disc you think it is.
Nothing. It's just a bunch of random garbage.
And it's not like it's encrypted or anything. I'd be able to tell.
Looks like Doc gave you a worthless piece of plastic and had you take it all the way here for nothing.
Don't know what to tell you. Wanna give him a call?
Yeah, she found me.
Doc, your disc is a bust. I don't know what you thought was on there, but it's not on there anymore, if it ever was.
Hey, uh... Is Bryn there with you, by any chance?
Only you would know, Doc. It's your whole scheme, after all.
At least I don't send random girls to do my dirty work!
Oh wait...
Bryn?!
Uh... hey! Haha...
Uhm... What's up?
I don't know. But this floppy disc she gave me has nothing on it.
You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?

responses.message: For the Skycorps mother ship? I'm not just gonna let them come and take over the island!

suite.message: She's so beautiful...
Sorry.
What do you even need those blueprints for, anyway?
Well you're like twenty years too late for that, but whatever.
Anyhow, something just crossed my mind.
I used to work with these kinds of discs a lot back at my government internship.
As soon as you put it into your computer, it stores an undetectable copy of the IP address.
Well, I say 'undetectable,' but nothing is undetectable to me.
Well, if there really is a floppy disc out there with those blueprints on it...
This fake was probably made with some intention behind it, you know?
It's likely they were both plugged into the same computer at some point.
What I'm saying is, if that other floppy disc is currently plugged into a running computer, I can intercept its signal.
Then all I would have to do is cross-reference its IP address with the hidden register on this fake one.
If you give me a few hours, I can potentially tell you where that other floppy disc is, if it exists.
It's a longshot, I know, but it's all I got.
Great. So, we're gonna be here a while... You wanna order a pizza?
I have some in the fridge.
Now, let's do some digging...

responses.message: That's fine. I'll go find Boris and get the disc. Can you mark the location on my map?
Uhm. Yeah, I'll be sure to do that.

suite.message: Alright, I think I've finally got it.
There is another floppy disc with the same IP address not too far from here actually. It's in a place called Hoarder's Cave...
Yeah, and you'd have to take Death Road to get there if you fancy the trip.
Yeah, not exactly promising.
The computer only has one registered user, and his name is Boris Hazard. That ring any bells?
Well, I hope he's a nice guy, because you're probably going to have to meet him if you want that floppy disc.
By the way, I'm not promising you'll find any blueprints. I'm just giving you all the info I can.
Sure thing. I'd tell Bryn and Doc, but their line is disconnected right now.
If she calls you on your field telephone, tell Bryn I'd love for her to come visit someday.
It gets pretty lonely here...

responses.message: Will you continue being the Ashtown Bandit?

suite.message: Hey. Good luck getting to Hoarder's Cave.
Let's see here...
Yeah, looks like I could combine the Wasp and the Gnat to make a powerful automatic gun. You want me to go for it?
Cool! I'll take that...
And that...
Just a moment now...
Boom. All done.
Here you go!
Sure, why not?
It gives me something to do.
I'm going crazy cooped up in this hideout all day...
